repository.note: Repository has no commits yet; all work exists as a working tree. Validation was performed directly against the working tree, not a diff.

criticalIssues.title: Self-signup could claim an EXISTING school as SCHOOL_ADMIN
criticalIssues.fix: Self-signup now requires one atomic WriteBatch creating the school AND the profile together; rules verify this with getAfter()/existsAfter() and require the school did not exist before the write.
criticalIssues.evidence: firestore-tests/rules.test.mjs: 'ATTACK: a fresh account cannot self-claim SCHOOL_ADMIN of an EXISTING school' (fails on pre-fix rules, passes on current rules)

highIssues.title: A profile could reference a schoolId for a school that was never created (orphan tenant)
highIssues.fix: Same isSelfSignupBatchFor() fix as SEC-01 closes this too.
highIssues.evidence: firestore-tests/rules.test.mjs: 'ATTACK: a fresh account cannot create a profile pointing at a school it never created'

highIssues.title: A SCHOOL_ADMIN could change their own school's status field (e.g. lift a platform-level suspension)
highIssues.fix: School-admin updates are now restricted to profile fields only via request.resource.data.diff(resource.data).affectedKeys().hasOnly([...]); status is excluded.
highIssues.evidence: firestore-tests/rules.test.mjs: 'a school admin cannot change their own school status (e.g. lift a platform suspension)'

highIssues.title: createdBy/updatedBy and createdAt/updatedAt were client-supplied, not server-enforced
highIssues.fix: validCreateAudit()/validUpdateAudit() now require createdAt/updatedAt == request.time and createdBy/updatedBy == request.auth.uid; createdAt/createdBy are immutable on update.
highIssues.evidence: firestore-tests/rules.test.mjs: 'audit fields cannot be forged on create or update'

mediumIssues.title: RolePermissions granted BRANCH_ADMIN the manageUsers permission in the Dart UI layer, but firestore.rules had no corresponding path for a branch admin to create/update users
mediumIssues.fix: Added isBranchAdminOf-scoped create/update rules for /users restricted to TEACHER/FINANCE/PARENT within the admin's own branch.
mediumIssues.evidence: firestore-tests/rules.test.mjs: 'a branch admin can manage users only within their own branch, never escalate'

mediumIssues.title: An INVITED (not-yet-activated) user profile was never explicitly rejected by TenantContextNotifier and would resolve to a full, usable TenantContext
mediumIssues.fix: Check widened to 'status != active', generalized AccountDisabledException to AccountInactiveException(status), added /account-inactive page distinguishing invited vs. disabled messaging.
mediumIssues.evidence: test/widget/app_router_test.dart: 'signed in, INVITED profile -> account-inactive page (not a splash retry loop)'

mediumIssues.title: Route-level permission enforcement and nav-item visibility were two separate, independently-maintained checks (app_router.dart vs. app_shell.dart) that could silently drift apart
mediumIssues.fix: Centralized into AppRoutes.requiredPermissions — one map both the router redirect and AppShell's nav filter read from.
mediumIssues.evidence: test/widget/app_router_test.dart: 'parent cannot open /school by URL' and 'teacher cannot open /school but can open /users'; mutation-tested by temporarily disabling the guard and confirming the tests fail

mediumIssues.title: sendPasswordResetEmail's user-not-found FirebaseAuthException would surface as a generic failure, which — combined with success returning silently — created a timing/behavior difference an attacker could use to enumerate registered emails
mediumIssues.fix: user-not-found is now treated as success in the repository, so the UI shows the same 'if an account exists...' message regardless.
mediumIssues.evidence: Code review; no emulator-based Auth test exists for this (Firebase Auth emulator for this specific flow was not stood up — see Known Issues)

mediumIssues.title: signOut() called Firebase sign-out and Google sign-out in one try/catch; a failure in the (non-critical) Google sign-out step would be reported as a sign-out failure even though the Firebase session was already cleared
mediumIssues.fix: Google sign-out is now a separate, best-effort step: logged on failure, never thrown.

lowIssues.title: FIRESTORE_ARCHITECTURE.md and MULTI_TENANT_GUIDE.md incorrectly stated that Firestore rules cannot see other writes in the same batch, used to justify a two-phase (non-atomic) school-creation write
lowIssues.fix: Corrected: getAfter()/existsAfter() DO see the batch's resulting state. Documentation rewritten to describe the single-batch design and includes a visible correction note.

lowIssues.title: Stale Flutter-template TODO comment left in Android build config
lowIssues.fix: Removed the 'TODO: Specify your own unique Application ID' comment (the applicationId is already set and was never actually a TODO).

acceptedDesignTradeoffs.title: No Firebase Auth custom claims / no Cloud Functions
acceptedDesignTradeoffs.detail: Tenant isolation uses a Firestore-rules lookup-table pattern (get() against the caller's own /users/{uid}) instead of custom claims, specifically because it needs no Cloud Functions deployment and is fully testable against the emulator today. Documented in SECURITY_ARCHITECTURE.md as a deliberate, revisitable tradeoff, not a gap.

knownLimitations: No real Firebase project exists yet — all firebase_options_<env>.dart files are gitignored placeholders. Nothing Firebase-backed (including the rules above) runs against a real backend; correctness is demonstrated via the Firestore emulator only.
Google Sign-In code is complete (Web popup + mobile google_sign_in token exchange) but cannot complete a real sign-in without a real Firebase project + registered OAuth client/SHA fingerprints.
No Users/School management UI exists (list staff, invite a user, change a role) — only the backend/rules/repository foundation. UsersPage is a placeholder.

SchoolStatus (ACTIVE/INACTIVE/SUSPENDED) is modeled and a SCHOOL_ADMIN can no longer self-modify it, but nothing currently enforces that a SUSPENDED school's users lose access — that behavior is undefined pending a product decision.

No Cloud Functions exist to create a Firebase Auth account for someone else; an admin can create a /users profile for a subordinate via rules, but provisioning the actual sign-in credential needs a server-side flow not yet built.
No custom in-app password-reset screen; relies on Firebase's hosted action-handler page.

firestore-tests/ (Node, @firebase/rules-unit-testing) is the only thing validating firestore.rules; there is no equivalent emulator-based test for Firebase Auth flows (email/password, Google) — those are validated by code review and Dart-side fakes only.

features.name: Google Sign-In (code complete; not runnable without a real Firebase project)
Tenant isolation (Firestore rules)
features.note: Critical hole (SEC-01/02) found and fixed during this validation; now covered by emulator tests.

features.name: School creation
features.note: Rewritten during validation from a two-phase write to one atomic WriteBatch.

features.name: User creation (admin provisioning a subordinate's Firestore profile)
features.note: Rules support it; no UI exists yet, and no flow creates the underlying Firebase Auth account for that user.

features.name: Account status (ACTIVE/INVITED/DISABLED) enforcement
features.note: INVITED handling was a gap (AUTH-01), fixed during validation.

features.name: Audit fields (createdAt/updatedAt/createdBy/updatedBy)
features.note: Server-side enforcement (SEC-04) was missing and is now added.

features.name: Error handling (user-facing messages, no raw exceptions)
Security-rule tests
